Public Function T(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, o As Object, typed As ListObject, s As String, again As Workbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws).Name = "Sheet2"
    ws.Activate
    ws.Range("A1:B1").Value = Array("K", "V")
    ws.Range("A2:B2").Value = Array(1, 2)
    ws.Range("A3:B3").Value = Array(3, 4)

    wb.Names.Add "Nm", "=Sheet1!$A$1"
    Set typed = ws.ListObjects(1)
    Set o = typed
    s = Read1(o)
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        o.AlternativeText = "abc"
    Case 1
        o.AlternativeText = ""
    Case 2
        o.AlternativeText = 5
    Case 3
        o.AlternativeText = 1.5
    Case 4
        o.AlternativeText = True
    Case 5
        o.AlternativeText = Null
    Case 6
        o.AlternativeText = Empty
    Case 7
        o.AlternativeText = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"

        typed.AlternativeText = "abc"

    Case 10

    Case 13
